_about: The Codex builds RAVIS has pinned (runbook §2.2 invariant 6; RAVIS.md §15.1.2). A binary is a tested build only when its sha256 and both schema-tree hashes match one entry here. strict_rules_proven stays false until calibration proves the file rules on that exact binary, and until then new Codex work stays paused (untested_version). R2 adds used_methods, strict_rules_surface and the definition hashes.

tested.evidence: Measured for RAVIS R1 from /opt/homebrew/Caskroom/codex/0.154.0/bin/codex, reached through the Homebrew link /opt/homebrew/bin/codex: signed by Apple team 2DC432GLL2, prints codex-cli 0.154.0, and both schema trees were generated in a throwaway Codex home under a sandbox denying network access and every write outside that home. The stable tree equals the reference recorded for ChatGPT.app's 0.154.0-alpha.6.2. Calibration proves the file rules (STATUS.md, Codex engine build plan).
